plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and cutting concentration. Expect lower potential gains but also a much lower chance of large losses.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to small positions.
Reduce exposure in AI/Software leveraged plays (METU, MSFU, PLTU).
Buy OXY, a top-rated scanner setup, to add diversification.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% monthly return by focusing on risk-first growth. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to AI/Software leveraged plays (METU, MSFU, PLTU).

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration, including leveraged ETFs. It aims to maximize gains but comes with substantially higher risk and potential for large, rapid losses. Leveraged ETF decay is a factor.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) and high-beta AI/Software plays.

This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating ETFs and broad market exposure. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to minimize volatility and preserve capital. Distributions are variable and NAV can still decline.
